typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CALLS_RECEIVED as string,
		CALLS_ANSWERED as string,
		ABANDONMENT_RATE as string,
		CALL_HOLD_RATE as string,
		TOTAL_HOLD_TIME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::SelectQuery',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> InfoMartTable
InfoMartTable derive(Sequence = '1',
		{MCO Name} = 'WLP',
		{Responsible Entity} = 'INH',
		{State Fiscal Year} = toString((iif($QueryMonth <= 8, $QueryYear, $QueryYear + 1))),
		Program = '02',
		{Hotline Type} = 'SC',
		{BH Detail} = 'NC',
		{Reporting Month} = right('0' + toString($QueryMonth), 2),
		Entity = '',
		Answered = toString(CALLS_ANSWERED),
		Abandoned = toString(ABANDONMENT_RATE),
		Hold = toString(CALL_HOLD_RATE),
		{Total Hold} = toString(TOTAL_HOLD_TIME),
		Received = toString(CALLS_RECEIVED)) ~> ConvertAndAddValues
ConvertAndAddValues sink(input(
		State_Fiscal_Year as string,
		Program as string,
		Sequence as string,
		Reporting_Month as string,
		Total_Hold_Time as string,
		Calls_Received as string,
		BH_Detail as string,
		Calls_Abandonment_Rate as string,
		Calls_Answered as string,
		Hotline_Type as string,
		Responsible_Entity as string,
		Call_Hold_Rate as string,
		MCO_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		State_Fiscal_Year = {State Fiscal Year},
		Program,
		Sequence,
		Reporting_Month = {Reporting Month},
		Total_Hold_Time = {Total Hold},
		Calls_Received = Received,
		BH_Detail = {BH Detail},
		Calls_Abandonment_Rate = Abandoned,
		Calls_Answered = Answered,
		Hotline_Type = {Hotline Type},
		Responsible_Entity = {Responsible Entity},
		Call_Hold_Rate = Hold,
		MCO_Name = {MCO Name})) ~> HotlineFlatFile
